recentItems.title: "It's Intense!" The Russo Brothers on 'Avengers: Doomsday' & Connecting 'Avengers: Endgame: Encore'
recentItems.description:

They talk about how these newly added scenes add a new filter to the lens with which audiences will watch 'Endgame', the duality of Robert Downey Jr. playing both Iron Man and Victor Von Doom, and how the X-Men will be pivotal to balancing the new Avengers roster.
